name: quizmania-platform
description: Reusable Quiz Management Platform with Private Admin and Public Quiz Applications

scripts.build:public: npm run build --workspace=@quizmania/types && npm run build --workspace=@quizmania/shared && npm run build --workspace=@quizmania/quiz-schema && npm run build --workspace=@quizmania/public
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@quizmania/shared && npm run test --workspace=@quizmania/quiz-schema && npx tsx apps/admin/src/lib/ollama/__tests__/ollama-generator.test.ts && npx tsx --tsconfig apps/admin/tsconfig.json apps/admin/src/lib/__tests__/auth-routes.test.ts && npx tsx apps/public/src/app/api/quizzes/__tests__/start-route.test.ts
